verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim fine-grained reactivity through Signals for fast state updates, and a production user cites AOT compilation and great performance. Together these suggest the framework, not the developer, handles efficient DOM updates. The evidence never states that a compiler turns components into surgical, targeted DOM updates. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the template compiler and how it generates targeted DOM update code, explicit evidence that no manual diffing is needed, independent technical corroboration of surgical updates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler to translate my components into efficient, surgical DOM updates instead of writing manual diffing code

citations.quote: Reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals
great performance, friendly community, AOT and tree-shaking
optimized code renders about 2x faster than other frameworks
